title: 第9章 杨婵把龙吉给揍了第10章 兵发灌江口
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
;;
到了晚上，杨易毫不意外的被赶到了偏房去睡，没办法小姨子来了自己只能让让。
龙吉公主跟瑶姬在一起，却毫无睡意，本来就是修行之人，习惯了打坐修炼。
龙吉公主挽着瑶姬，道：“姐姐，我看这姐夫就是一个不学无术之人，一点都不靠谱，尤其是我那小侄女，竟然让一个人间武夫去教。”
瑶姬莞尔一笑，道：“龙吉，你就是对凡人的成见太深了，你姐姐我这一辈子有了这么一个知心人已经足够了。”
随后瑶姬看向了龙吉，道：“你来灌江口也看到了，灌江龙王在那灌江口作祟，引得这灌口洪水滔天，定然是天庭发现了端倪。我打算回天庭一趟，去直面我大哥，跟他说明这一切，希望他能成全于我。”
“只希望大哥看在我跟杨易的情分上，能网开一面，就算让我做一辈子凡人，我也知足了。”
龙吉摇了摇头，她实在想不明白，这姐夫有什么好，值得瑶姬如此付出。
要知道瑶姬在天庭地位超然，她乃天庭昊天的妹妹，先天一缕七情六欲之气化形，修到了五气朝元，三花聚顶的大罗金仙之境。
如今在这人间，跌了先天根性不说，还冒犯天规，嫁给了一个凡人，还给那个凡人生下了三个孩子。
龙吉道：“昊天大帝那里还好说，可王母娘娘素来重视这天条天规，她岂能在此事上罢休。”
瑶姬叹了一口气，道：“我只盼着这件事不会波及到杨易，这一次之所以将你带回杨家村，就是希望有一天我不在了，你能照顾一下我三个可怜的孩子，只不过你现在也是戴罪之身，切记不可莽撞，一切只能在暗中行事。”
龙吉信誓旦旦的点了点头，道：“龙吉定然把姐姐的嘱咐放在心上。”
两姐妹一直聊到很晚，见到瑶姬睡了过去，龙吉端坐在床上，陷入了入定之中，随后元神出窍，前去寻找杨婵的踪迹。
她倒要看看，杨易给杨婵找了一个什么样的老师，小小年纪就留宿在外，她这个当姑姑的定然要好好看看，那个所谓的孔宣是个什么货色。
若是这孔宣也不是什么好人，她这一次回青鸾斗阙就把杨婵带回去，亲自去教，可不能让别人糟蹋了这么一个好苗子。
龙吉的元神在夜风中凝实，神识在杨家村一扫，这凡间别的不说，晚上倒是清净。
没有天庭那些烦人的朝会，没有王母身边那些整日勾心斗角的仙娥，也没有那些表面恭敬、背地里嚼舌根的闲人。
她收回思绪，只是元神一扫，便在杨家村寻找到了那一处庐蓬所在。
一般修为高深之人，都会喜欢以庐蓬为临时住所，只因这庐蓬也唤作芦棚，蓬莱山在海中，大人之市在海中，大有高深之士隐于市的道理。

“看这庐蓬倒是像模像样，估计这位也是仰慕那些修仙之人，在这里搭了这庐蓬。”
“我倒要看看，这个喜欢装逼的孔宣究竟有几分道行，别在姑奶奶手中撑不住一个回合。”
龙吉可是金仙大能，距离那太乙金仙也只有一步之遥，先天壬水根脚在身，自认为在这三界之中也有几分分量。
很快龙吉便窥探到了，庐蓬当中有一个十来岁的小女孩正在玩着一根羽毛，正是那杨婵。
龙吉眉头一皱，这大半夜的不让孩子睡觉，在这里玩鸟毛，这孔宣教的都是一些什么乱七八糟的。
经过了一番心理建设，龙吉已经肯定了下来，这孔宣就是一个不学无术、喜欢装逼、不懂装懂的人间莽夫。
她还不知道，这个时候庐蓬当中，杨婵转过头来看了正在打坐的孔宣一眼，小声道：“师父，天上好像有什么东西在看着咱们。”

At night, Yang Yi was not surprised to be driven to a side room to sleep. He had no choice but to give in when his sister-in-law came.
Princess Long Ji and Yao Ji were together, but they were not sleepy at all. They were practitioners and were used to meditating.
Princess Long Ji put her arm around Yao Ji and said, "Sister, I think this brother-in-law is an ignorant and incompetent person. He is not reliable at all. Especially my little niece, she asked a human martial artist to teach her."
Yao Ji smiled and said: "Long Ji, you are too prejudiced against mortals. It is enough for me to have such an intimate person like your sister in my life."
Then Yao Ji looked at Long Ji and said: "You saw it when you came to the Guanjiang estuary. The Dragon King of Guanjiang was causing trouble at the Guanjiang estuary, causing the Guankou to flood. Heaven must have discovered the clues. I plan to go back to Heaven to face my elder brother and explain all this to him. I hope he can help me."
"I just hope that my eldest brother will be accommodating because of my friendship with Yang Yi. Even if I am asked to be a mortal for the rest of my life, I will be satisfied."
Long Ji shook her head. She really couldn't understand why this brother-in-law was so good that he deserved Yao Ji's sacrifice.
You must know that Yao Ji has a transcendent status in the heaven. She is the sister of Haotian in the heaven. She has a wisp of innate Qi of seven emotions and six desires. She has cultivated to the realm of Da Luo Jinxian with five Qi facing the Yuan and three flowers gathering at the top.
Now in this world, not only did she lose her innate nature, but she also violated the laws of heaven by marrying a mortal and giving birth to three children to that mortal.
Long Ji said: "It's okay for Emperor Haotian, but the Queen Mother has always attached great importance to this heavenly rule. How can she give up on this matter?"
Yao Ji sighed and said: "I just hope that this matter will not affect Yang Yi. The reason why I brought you back to Yangjiacun this time is that one day I am gone and you can take care of my three poor children. However, you are also guilty now. Remember not to be reckless. Everything can only be done in secret."
Long Ji nodded confidently and said, "Long Ji will definitely take sister's instructions to heart."
The two sisters chatted until very late. When they saw Yao Ji sleeping, Long Ji sat on the bed and fell into trance. Then his soul left his body and went to look for traces of Yang Chan.
She wanted to see what kind of teacher Yang Yi found for Yang Chan. She stayed out at a young age. As an aunt, she must take a good look at what the so-called Kong Xuan was.
If Kong Xuan is not a good person, she will take Yang Chan back to Qingluan Douque this time and teach her in person. She cannot let others ruin such a good young talent.
Long Ji's soul solidified in the night wind, and his consciousness swept across Yangjiacun. Not to mention anything else in this mortal world, it was peaceful at night.
There are no annoying court meetings in heaven, there are no fairies around the Queen Mother who scheming all day long, and there are no idlers who are respectful on the surface but gossip behind their backs.
She retracted her thoughts, and with just a sweep of her soul, she found the hut in Yangjiacun.
Generally, people with advanced cultivation would like to use a huteng as a temporary residence, because this huteng is also called a reed shed. Penglai Mountain is in the sea, and the market of adults is in the sea. There is a reason for advanced people to hide in the market.
"Looking at this tent, it looks pretty decent. I guess this person also admires those who are cultivating immortals, so he built this tent here."
"I'd like to see how well Kong Xuan, who likes to show off, can survive a round in the hands of my aunt."
Long Ji is a powerful Golden Immortal, and he is only one step away from the Taiyi Golden Immortal. He has the innate Renshui roots in his body, and he thinks he has some weight in the three realms.
Soon Long Ji spied out. There was a little girl in her teens playing with a feather in the tent. It was Yang Chan.
Long Ji frowned. The children were not allowed to sleep in the middle of the night and were playing with bird feathers here. What Kong preached was all this mess.
After some psychological construction,Long Ji has already confirmed that Kong Xuan is a reckless man who is ignorant, likes to show off, and doesn't know how to pretend to understand.
She didn't know that at this time, Yang Chan turned around and glanced at Kong Xuan, who was meditating, and whispered: "Master, there seems to be something in the sky watching us."
